name: clima-core

scripts.build: if [ -d "frontend" ]; then cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* dist/ && mkdir -p frontend/dist && cp -r dist/* frontend/dist/; else npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p frontend/dist && cp -r dist/* frontend/dist/; fi
